about: Tracks and their stages in order (SPEC §4). stages.py reads this file; it never hard-codes the order.

full.label: Full production
full.when: A full piece of content: research to hand-off, ending in the Higgsfield hand-off (assets uploaded + Canvas build sheet).

single.label: Single asset
single.when: One asset: an icon, a thumbnail, a single shot.

refine.label: Prompt refinement
refine.when: The user only wants a prompt. Quick questions, then a prompt card. No generation at all.
